Bill.BriefDescription: Imposing a fee on professional athletes to fund community outdoor athletic facilities.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to a fee on professional athletes; adding a newchapter to Title 82 RCW; and providing an effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The definitions in this section applythroughout this chapter unless the context clearly requires otherwise. (a)(i) "Duty day" means any day during the year in which a memberof a professional athletic team or a member of a sports entertainmentbusiness competes, or is scheduled to compete, in a facility that ispartially or wholly financed by the public. (ii) For each member of a professional athletic team or a sportsentertainment business, "duty day" excludes: (A) Any day for which the member is not compensated and is notrendering services in any manner, including days when the member hasbeen suspended without pay and prohibited from performing any servicesfor the team; and (B) Any day for which the member is not rendering services in anymanner due to placement on a disabled list. (b) "Member of a professional athletic team" means an employee, orindependent contractor, of a professional athletic team who is a player p. 1 HB 2401or driver. "Member of a professional athletic team" does not includepersons other than players or drivers, such as coaches, managers,trainers, or crew chiefs. (c) "Member of a sports entertainment business" means an employee,or independent contractor, of a sports entertainment business who is aboxer, kickboxer, wrestling participant, or martial arts participant."Member of a sports entertainment business" does not include personsother than participants, such as promoters, managers, inspectors,timekeepers, announcers, referees, or medical personnel. (d) "Nonresident professional athletic team" means a professionalathletic team that is domiciled outside of Washington. (e) "Professional athletic team" means any professional baseball,basketball, football, or motorsports team, that is a member of anational league or association of significance. (f) "Sports entertainment business" means a company that promotesboxing, martial arts, or wrestling events, or any combination of theseevents, and the events are not exempt from licensing under RCW67.08.015. (2) The meanings attributed to words and phrases in chapter 67.08RCW apply to the provisions of this chapter relating to a fee onmembers of sports entertainment businesses.

(1) For the privilege of performing beforepaying audiences in publicly financed facilities, a fee is imposed oneach member of a professional athletic team and each member of a sportsentertainment business, for each duty day that occurs in the state ofWashington. The fee is fifty dollars per member per duty day. (2) The department of revenue shall administer the fee imposed onmembers of professional athletic teams. The operator of the facilityin which a professional athletic team competes shall collect the fee onthe duty day from each member of a professional athletic team. Theoperator shall file a return with the department of revenue on amonthly basis. The return must include the following: (a) The number of duty days during the return period for eachplayer who is a member of a professional athletic team; and (b) Remittance of the player's fee or fees for that month. (3) The department of licensing shall administer the fee imposed on HB 2401 p. 2 members of sports entertainment businesses. The fee must be collectedat the same time the fee under RCW 67.08.050 is collected. (4) The revenue from fees collected under this chapter must bedeposited into the youth athletic facility account created in RCW43.99N.060. (5) The fee applies to both resident and nonresident members ofprofessional athletic teams and sports entertainment businesses.

(1) All of chapter 82.32 RCW, except RCW82.32.270, applies to the fee imposed under section 2(1) of this act,in addition to any other provisions of law for the payment andenforcement of this fee. (2) The department of revenue and the department of licensing mayadopt rules for the administration of this chapter.
Sections 1 through 3 of this act constitutea new chapter in Title 82 RCW.
